proposals.title: Approve auto-optimization batch — 11 weaknesses fixed
proposals.description: OpenClaw fixed 11 items: Striker OOM limits (512MB), log rotation, health dashboard, credential lockdown, stale awareness fix, event bus cleanup, 7 tracker files consolidated, dialogue tracking, service config validator, port conflict resolved. Approve locks these as compound policy.

nemoclaw.rationale: 11 fixes already deployed and verified. Locking as policy prevents regression. Only concern: verify credential lockdown actually rotated secrets vs just restricting access to them.
